name: Next Beverly Hills Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Next Beverly Hills Committee
  will conduct a Special Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address the
  agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  Room 280A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  IN-PERSON I TELEPHONIC I VIDEO CONFERENCE MEETING

  Beverly Hills Liaison Committee Meeting
  https://beverlyhil ls-org.zoom.uslmylnextbh
  Meeting ID: 511 714 8143

  You can also dial in by phone:
  +1 346 248 7799 US

  +18335480282,51171481 43#,,,,*9021 0# US Toll-free

  Tuesday, January 14, 2025
  6:30 PM

Please be advised that pre-entry metal detector screening requirements are now in place
in City Hall. Members of the public are requested to plan visits accordingly.

In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, members of the public can view this
meeting through live webcast at www.beverIyhills.orç/live and on BH Channel 10 or Channel
35 on Spectrum Cable, and can participate in the teleconference/video conference by using the
link above. Written comments may be emailed to mayorandcitycouncil(âbeverlyhilIs.org and
will also be taken during the meeting when the topic is being reviewed by the Beverly Hills City
Council Liaison / Next Beverly Hills Committee. Beverly Hills Liaison meetings will be in-person
at City Hall.

Mission Statement: NEXT Beverly Hills (“NBH”) is a committee of talented, next generation leaders
focused on innovative initiatives which address lifestyle, economic, and civic needs of those in their 20’s,
30’s and 40’s. Chartered by the Mayor and the City of Beverly Hills, it seeks to engage all who are interested
to inspire them to make Beverly Hills a better place for all.

  AGENDA

1)  Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on any
  item not listed on the agenda.
 2) Welcome & Introductions
  a. Next Beverly Hills Chair Ellen Labbé
  b. City Council Liaisons Mayor Lester Friedman & Councilmember Mary Wells
  Staff Liaisons Keith Sterling (Deputy City Manager) and Stephanie Harris (Director of
  Community Services)
  c. Introduction of new attendees

3)  New Business
  i. 2025 areas of focus
  1. Networking opportunities and events
  a. Arts&culture
  b. Sustainability
  c. Next Night
  2. Civic education, collaboration, and outreach
  a. Introduction to city departments and civic issues
  ii. Prospective events
  1. Honoring Doris Day event
  2. Sustainability event
  3. Taste of Beverly Hills
  4. Biannual “Networking with Next”
  5. Group offsite activities

4) City Council Liaisons  —  Civic awareness updates

5)  City Staff  —  Announcements and upcoming events for the next generation

6) Current Business
  a. Open discussion for next-gen related information/opportunities/ideas

7) Adjournment
  a. The upcoming Next Beverly Hills Committee meeting date will be shared once a date is
  selected. Thursday, February 13, 2025 will be canceled and rescheduled.

ciJI
Huma Ahmed
City Clerk
